cr_data.provenance: The artist (ca. 1923–d. 1986); her bequest as part of the Alfred Stieglitz Collection to MMA) (Source: The Met, 2025)

remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature" [note of backing inscription 1]. Whitney Archive indicates, "Photo from gallery photo. of O'Keeffe exh. at An American Place. Probably 1934 exh. for which I have no catalogue. The 1933–34 exhibitions were mainly of miscellaneous early ptgs." Abiquiú Notebooks indicates star from backing inscription 3. Pictured in 1934 New York (An American Place) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 56. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Lynes publication lists date as 1923–1924. The Met assigns date of ca. 1923 (Source: The Met, 2025).
